caption: This looks sensitive and structured, but nothing built-in recognizes the PLACEKEY pattern.

code:
-- next let's test the Regular Expression (Regex) that our Data Engineer
-- has created to locate the Placekey value
SELECT
    placekey
FROM raw_pos.location
WHERE placekey REGEXP('^[a-zA-Z0-9d]{3}-[a-zA-Z0-9d]{3,4}@[a-zA-Z0-9d]{3}-[a-zA-Z0-9d]{3}-.*$');
caption: Test the regex as a plain SELECT before wiring it into a classifier.
13.1K rows matched — confirmed before wiring it up.
